description: Defines an abstract class RestSerializer responsible for serializing HTTP requests for AWS API operations, including building endpoints, handling headers, query parameters, and payloads.

classes.name: RestSerializer
classes.description: An abstract class for serializing AWS API requests into HTTP requests, handling endpoint construction, headers, query parameters, and payloads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with the AWS service description and endpoint URI.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a command into an HTTP request, setting headers, URI, and body.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Prepares request options including headers, query parameters, and payload based on the operation and input arguments.

methods.name: applyPayload
methods.description: Sets the request body payload, handling streaming and string/blob types.

methods.name: applyHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the request, formatting timestamp and boolean types, and encoding JSON values.

methods.name: applyHeaderMap
methods.description: Adds multiple headers from a map, used mainly in S3.

methods.name: applyQuery
methods.description: Adds query parameters, formatting booleans and timestamps.

methods.name: buildEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the request URI based on operation, arguments, and endpoint configuration.

methods.name: hasPayloadParam
methods.description: Checks if the input shape has a payload parameter.

methods.name: appendQuery
methods.description: Appends query parameters to the endpoint URI.

methods.name: getVarDefinitions
methods.description: Extracts URI variable definitions from command input.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Ensures the endpoint path ends with a slash for proper URI resolution.
